IC.justification: IC Base-CN excess increases strictly monotonically across all strata: S1 (-0.002) -> S2 (+0.002) -> S3 (+0.012) -> S4 (+0.043) -> S5 (+0.083), and prevalence increases from 46.7% to 98.2%.
IC.recommended_wording: parameter-space reorganization became progressively stronger with snow activity

dPL.justification: dPL Base-CN excess rises steeply from S1 (+0.019) -> S2 (+0.056) -> S3 (+0.127) -> S4 (+0.132), then plateaus in S5 (+0.125). S5 exerts high leverage that pulls down the linear slope across [0, 0.91].
dPL.recommended_wording: parameter-space reorganization was increasingly organized across the snow-activity gradient, steep across moderate snow regimes (S2-S4) and plateauing in high-snow basins (S5)

delta_beta_explanation.reason: In dPL, Base-CN excess saturates in S5, exerting downward leverage on the global slope (pulling beta_CN from +0.427 in S1-S4 down to +0.197 in Full). TGD also plateaus (pulling beta_TGD from +0.341 down to +0.156). In the active transition zone S1-S4 (ExcludeS5), CN separates from Base at rate +0.427 vs TGD rate +0.341, yielding Delta_beta = +0.086. Structural differentiation persists below S5 and is not an S5 artifact.
